problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must schedule a technician to perform maintenance at four different regional facilities.

The travel times between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility Alpha to Beta: 129.2 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Gamma: 46.6 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Delta: 139.6 minutes
* Facility Beta to Gamma: 86.3 minutes
* Facility Beta to Delta: 58.3 minutes
* Facility Gamma to Delta: 110.3 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circuit that allows the technician to arrive at each facility precisely one time, concluding the tour back at the initial facility.
